answer: The mechanism is a capital bond paid in copper at registration, slashed on any collusion verdict. Each new identity must lock a stake equal to one epoch's honest earnings, so identity costs real funds. An operator spinning up a thousand sybils must post a thousand times the bond, refunded only after a long relic of steady, verdict-checked work. A violet flag marks fresh bonds as low-trust, so their votes count fractionally until aged. Faking many voices costs capital per voice, and one detected cluster burns it all, forcing profit negative.
